title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2611.18453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble methods deliver this aleatoric/epistemic decomposition in principle, but are computationally prohibitive at LLM scale and require white-box access. Existing black-box methods, in contrast, summarize to a single scalar that cannot make the distinction. We introduce a two-level ensemble that bridges this gap. Stochastic decoding of a fixed prompt forms the inner ensemble; meaning-preserving semantic perturbations of the prompt form the outer ensemble. Variability is measured in a continuous embedding space, and the law of total covariance gives an exact within-/between-perturbation decomposition to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty (AU/EU); it requires only black-box sampling access. translated_title: 基于集成之集成的大语言模型黑盒不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 可靠地使用大语言模型（LLM）需要不确定性估计，以区分提示词固有的模糊性与真正的知识缺口。贝叶斯方法和深度集成方法在原则上能够提供这种偶然性/认知性的分解，但在LLM规模上计算成本过高，且需要白盒访问。相比之下，现有的黑盒方法只能将其总结为单一标量，无法做出上述区分。我们引入了一种两级集成方法来弥合这一差距。对固定提示词进行随机解码构成内层集成；对提示词进行保义语义扰动构成外层集成。变异性在连续嵌入空间中进行测量，全协方差定律给出了精确的扰动内/扰动间分解，从而估计偶然性不确定性与认知性不确定性（AU/EU）；该方法仅需要黑盒采样访问。在此估计器的基础上，我们提出了三项理论结果（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅需黑盒访问的两级“集成之集成”方法，通过对固定提示词随机解码构成内层集成、对提示词进行语义扰动构成外层集成，并利用全协方差定律在嵌入空间中精确分解大语言模型的偶然性不确定性与认知性不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a black-box two-level ensemble-of-ensembles method that forms an inner ensemble via stochastic decoding and an outer ensemble via semantic prompt perturbations, using the law of total covariance to exactly decompose aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty for LLMs.
